posts.body:
what's up, im new to RPG maker XP and am trying to fiddle with it to figure stuff out. i wanted to know if its possible to make the sprites for the player and any other npc for that matter any size i want, or does it HAVE to be pixel art.
thank you

If I recall well, there's no size limit, but it will need to be converted to the appropriate file (.png or similar I think) and the grid must match the standard of the engine.

posts.author: Ethernite
posts.body: There's no size limit as long as you follow the format.

posts.author: SleepySalami
posts.body: oh sweet! that comes in handy. thank yall for answering. i appreciate it.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
SleepySalami said:
any size i want, or does it HAVE to be pixel art.
Click to expand...
Those two things are not connected. You can draw large pictures that are pixel art and small pictures that are not.
Pixel art is a style, not a measurement of size.
